title: Bulk Paper

onscreen_lines.desc: Specification Qty UOM Type 1 ITEM DESCRIPTION: Requests must list any and all exceptions on a separate, attached sheet. Vendors may offer one alternative to specific items UNLESS SPECIFIED. Prices shall include shipping, handling and freight charges and all shipments are FOB CCISD. Shipping requirements: Paper must be forward loaded 20# 8.5” X 11” Multi-Purpose white copy paper, 96 brightness, 500 sheet per ream, 10 reams per case, 840 cases per truckload – Global or Suitable Substitute Each Vendor is required to: Send a case for sampling. Samples are due to the warehouse by July 23, 2026. Supply local references. References must be received at the same time the samples are delivered. Must be willing to stagger the delivery dates. Be willing to comply with the 1 – 3 pm delivery time. Required to disclose how many mills are used. State their policy should a customer have problems with the paper.
